description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the PerformanceReviewDao class within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It verifies database operations related to performance reviews, including retrieval, creation, updating, and handling of exceptions.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing various methods of PerformanceReviewDao related to performance reviews management within the HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PerformanceReviewDao instance and loads test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Verifies that getPerformanceReviewList returns the correct count of performance reviews based on filter.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Verifies that getPerformanceReviewCount returns the correct number of reviews matching the filter.

methods.name: testGetEditableReviewById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of editable performance review by ID, including cases where review is absent.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Tests retrieval of supervisor records for an employee under different scenarios.

methods.name: testCreateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that createReview properly throws TransactionException if persistence fails.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that updateReview properly throws TransactionException if persistence fails.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Verifies the status message returned based on self-reviewer's status.

methods.name: testUpdateReviewerComment
methods.description: Checks that updating reviewer comments correctly modifies the database record.
